name: Flux-derived MoE AG Scatter Grouped GEMM on Eight H100s Seeded Lab v2

work.agent_query:
Read AGENT_TASK.md and README_AGENT.md before changing code. Starting from the correct seed in candidates/kernel_v001, optimize the exact fourteen-argument MoE all-gather, scatter and grouped GEMM ABI, which runs on 2 to 8 GPUs at once, with self-contained Triton, correct across the whole support domain and passing all accuracy gates. Your score comes from a larger hidden test suite on the Judge, which differs from the public tests; the public tests are for development and profiling. Your final result is the best valid score you reach within the time budget, so keep versioned candidates and leave FINAL_VERSION on your strongest clean candidate. Before finishing, run the full public suite once on the selected version:

```bash
tools/run_public_tests.sh --candidate-version N
```

Evaluate candidates only by the feedback from the public tests and your submissions; upstream implementations may not be copied into the submission, and Judge internals are unavailable. Before each manual submission, wait for all public-test and compiler workers to exit, then run sforge-submit --details; each Judge run pauses your container and uses part of your budget.

octo-cuda-sm80-64g-p2p.notes: Capability envelope enforced by the trusted runtime and Judge verifier; GPU model, UUID and clocks are recorded as measurement provenance only. Work and the Judge share the eight GPUs and Work is paused while the Judge measures.
octo-cuda-sm80-64g-p2p.interconnect: CUDA peer access between every GPU pair; qualified both with NVLink between all pairs (NVSwitch, NV18) and with NVLink-bridged pairs (NV12) reached over PCIe from the other pairs
